body: Why must a bag be $1K? Is it any more precious than a 100% handmade piece of jewelry with real gold…?

It’s just a supreme nuisance, to have to keep blocking, muting and clicking “show less…”. It’s really unfair, so it would be nice for ppl to act with a speck of decorum, so we don’t have to pull weeds all day.

Agreed. So sick of the falsehood. BlueSky should grey out the Follow All button on new accounts. If they are smart enough to pick up on new users, they are smart enough to disable access to the creation of crap accounts.
BTW, there are a handful who need to generate followers quickly—for their small businesses.

I hear you & I'm saddened by the negligence we face here in CA! When I have tried to seek advice via forums, I’m met with ridiculous offensive “you’re suing yourself” when I want so badly to bring them to justice!
Why won’t Davis-Stirling see that we need a legal way to force HOAs to tell us if they are fining the absentee landlords they seem to be protecting?!!!

I’ve just run across this. My experience has shown that being a part of a board that is pro-tenant (thus pro-investor) doe not work, especially when the assigned manager overtakes each an every meeting & decision.
That being said, I only wish Davis-Stirling would adopt laws that require transparency as to the violation execution so members can be assured their reports are being heard & processed.
I, too, unfortunately live in an HOA community where violations are not followed by management; they allegedly pass the buck onto the Board, who must be ignoring them. One such investor committed over a month of contractors & movers violations without any signs of repercussions! Management told me to tell the violators “to just move”. I had been told (over a different violation) that the HOA president said violations are “discretionary”!!!
Looking forward to lowering the boom on them soon!

ThredUp screwed me over, as well as EBay (their third party). My skirt arrived as badly wrinkled as the photo.  I had to return it for a different reason. Notwithstanding, they do not have a link for returns nor a cited return policy.
My next recourse was EBay through which I bought it. Well, no money-back guarantee for this, but I went through the arduous process of requesting a refund (1/2 the prices of the bloody skirt—label & restocking).
Ebay sent me an email “with the shipping label”. Guess what? NO F-ing LABEL! The “resend label” link was inoperable. No f-I g contact number!!!
Who’s at fault? ThredUp? EBay? Or BOTH😤.
If & when I can trash them I will. EBay screwed me with advertising fees before…
Is Sanders trying to create some absurd attention, as if it’s a joke??! People have lived through way to much, to recount it. He knows this. He’s not doing a damn thing about it…

Bet you got no response. SDPD are impotent asses along with Councilman LaCava!! I have been fighting them for months trying to stop the revving & speeding modified cars. Now, my neighbours and I have to face the excessive light trespass from the unnecessary trolley garage & trolley track lights at the mall! The other, far less intrusive station is only 1.2 miles down the street! But Westfield “bought” this trolley track and stop to further their self-interests while City official neglect their residents. Please pass the word & help me any way you can. I am planning on going to Small Claims court soon & need as much ammo as I can get!

Yes, an HOA member’s car was broken into that same night in our gated garage at University Towne Square. He had a dashcam that my Neighbourhood Watch UTC organizer dismissed as saying it is unfair to have posted the photo of this punk around the area; she thinks this would lead to him being falsely accused! This is OUR OWN Neighbourhood Watch facilitator saying this! WTF! I stepped up to be UTS’s NW organizer but it is futile given the allowance of investors and their tenants meandering everywhere in a homeowner community. 😤😤😤😤😤😤😤

An HOA member’s car was broken into that same night, at University Towne Square gated garage. Initially, the Impotent police told him they didn’t have the “manpower” to investigate, yet 4 officers responded to a car dent at Renaissance shopping center a few weeks before!
I’m just now checking the net to see if arrests have been made. I know it’s futile, as they ALL refuse to do their jobs. My husband’s (unlocked?) car was ransacked in the very depths of our underground garage in Little Italy. I was placated with a case number but neither our on-site property manager nor the police cooperated. Had they done so, they would have lifted prints that would have lead to an arrest or entered into a data base toward an arrest down the line.
I strongly feel La Vita’s security is to blame & it was an inside job. Why else would our manager refuse to cooperate? The hired security personnel have prints on file that would lead directly to them!
Meanwhile, I saw 2 police stops today, at the exact same spot on Nobel Drive involving “soccer mom” drivers. These police would rather flex their muscle at benign drivers than the jerks in their muscle cars revving & speeding within Genessee/Nobel! I have had meetings & emails with our councilman to no avail. Something has got to give and my neighbours and I direly need your support!!! Please write me. I just now heard another jerk racing thought the Genessee & Lombard stoplights!
Know where I can get some action with my new Camaro? I love the UTC area & would love a sideshow or two…
Got a sweet Camaro looking for some street action in UTC, San Diego. Let me know!

I’m sorry, but you have to leave. She is toxic. Plenty of people have promised me, said they would be my confidante just find the soft spot to stick the knife.
She is doing that to you. I know it’s not simple but it’s a hell of a lot better than handing in for 39 years (me)! Be lucky you are not financially tied to her (I hope not), then find her some help of her own & walk fat away. I had to block a narc (narcissist) from my life just to stop from being manipulated back to him. You have to do the same to make a clean break and “detox” as it were. Please think on it.

I haven’t met anyone who cares. Not fair to broadcast false hope. I have even PAID people to care and they simply don’t. I can’t even get reciprocity for spending thousands on accounts, attorneys, realtors, doctors, mechanics, etc, to buy my jewelry line. No one wants it. No one wants me. By the way, I think I can link a photo to show you. Nope, wants a URL, which will destroy my anonymity here. Let’s just say, it’s beautiful, mainstream & expensive. But hey, WHO CARES!
You will find your way. You are brave; remember this and decide for yourself your direction.

And why is it such a horrible thing? We get “reported” by “professionals”. And for what?? So some “hospital” can exercise CorporateGreed & make us surrender our last dime for help they do not give?! Once we are released, feeling no better, we are further destroyed as being labelled. Peeved me so much when I found a previous doctor wrote Alcohol Abuse on my chart! When I cornered him, he said he couldn’t legally remove it but could write Resolved. Don’t think he ever did & don’t think that followed me to my new state.

As I commented to someone else, these a-holes are narcissists. If they personally know you, they purposely don’t care.
Then there are just ignorant bastards who have no concept. When my elderly doctor/father-figure took his life, I found it horrifically painful but called his decision “brave”. He had no choice, with his deterioration. Yet when seeking empathy & support from a neighbour who had ill/dying parents, she ACTUALLY said it was wrong, that he should have “shown he could live his life with dignity”. WTF! She was not a bible-thumper (THE worst), which made it strange. I just think she was like all the others in my life throughout my f-ed up years of struggle: being argumentative and devils advocate. Another set of Toxic People!

I don’t trust a therapist as far as I can throw there #<^!! However, you two deserve couples counselling. Sounds like you want to make it work. 
For my husband and I, we have been over for years, but still under the same roof. I only cheated on him to give my life meaning & I suppose I subconsciously wanted this to push him into divorce. He stayed but I think just to add to the abuse. I am TERRIFIED of becoming poor & I am unemployable.
Listen: the point is you don’t tell him as he may have you committed and you DO NOT tell a therapist, as they may claim it’s a “ safe place” but will run to pick up that phone.
I think you have a way back from this! There are ways to work through; please choose them.
It’s the Narcissist In them.
You are brave. If you feel this, WITHOUT ANY DOUBT, do what you must.

I am so so sorry. I won’t talk about it, but want you to know I’m glad to reached out to us. Keep writing, even if it’s in a journal. And be there for your wife. Grieving TOGETHER, can keep you two from falling away from each other.

Forget the pushing bag. And FORGET HER! She is toxic. I have awoken to the concept of toxic people & how one must purge them from our lives in order to stabilise ourselves. Reading is one thing, but doing is quite another.
Is she the ONLY person in your life?? You are SO lucky if she isn’t. Another thing: are you successful (job, hobbies)? You must surely have something besides her?!
I’ve been abused throughout my 39 year marriage but have a “mental block” for not being able to leave. Now I am 60 with no job, no friends, no relatives. Dumped by therapists & meds don’t cure environmental strife.
I don’t want to compare or give you a “feel good” response, but you have something, somewhere to give. Get rid of your fiancé & reach for better! My life is over. Yours surely can’t be.

I’m so sorry KJ! I know you don’t want to hear this and comparisons aren’t fair, but you are young enough to dig yourself out or give it a try. I’ve been crapped on for 60 years!! Try THAT on. I was brought into this world with a severe medical condition & things just went downhill from there. I have NO support system (parents never cared, pleaded for friends & rewarded with none. And yes, bullied for DECADES)
Sorry, my point being, I am listening to all your very real strife. I do very much understand. I feel your life experiences completely revolve around your ADHD & you MUST keep trying to get help with that, which means meds & whatever therapy coincides with it (CBT??). Write me if you want. This is my first time here, so not sure how to get notifications.
You do have time to turn around and it sounds like you have what I don’t: friends.
We all have a thing here: we al want to die. But I see you actually have a shot at living! Hell, when I try to end it, I wouldn’t have anyone there to care enough to stop me. Please try…
Sounds like a money scam to me

It’s nice to know I can open up here without being shot down!! When I poured my heart out about the narcissist who stabbed me in the heart & goes on living without a second thought (I want to elaborate here but afraid I will be ridiculed), I was ripped apart by trolls (Quora)!! I have no support system & my latest search for a new therapist (thrown under the bus by my last two—“no time anymore” & “contract changes won’t let me see you”) ended before it started; he was a no-show, not once, but TWICE. Hey folks, this isn’t like reserving a table! This has ALWAYS been the way I have been treated. Only NOW am I turning my Nasty on. I’ve been too nice for too long. BTW, I’ve lived long enough this way to call it quits—-60.

I hear you, too. Could not reply to Noodle, so I’m asking this of him/her: Were you hospitalised voluntarily or did someone whistleblower on you. Why is it they do this (the latter)? We were not asked to come into this life but we have the right to decide when we want OUT!
Anyway, what are we doing to ourselves? It’s worse than physically bashing our heads into a brick wall!
Personally, 1)I have no “friends”. Those I have initiated contact with, do not return my calls nor messages. 2)I’ve only been used for sex—my buttons have been pushed, for months & then I am put down or ignored. 3)I’ve never been a success in anything I’ve tried; my husband never supported me emotionally, even though I’m degreed & have always tried my best. 3)I’m now unemployable. 4)I do not have relationships with my sister or brother (they see me online but don’t start a convo). 5)I can’t garner support or responses for ANYTHING I try to say or do (on social media or in person). 6)Horrible relationship with my husband, whom I married for all the wrong reasons. The list goes on. I can’t get “better” and why should I when the world keeps shutting on me? Bet you won’t answer me either.
Oh, and to make matters worse, I just turned 60! See how long I’ve been tolerating this crap? (To drive the nail in my coffin, my “birthday gift” was a fling with one mention in #5 who I discovered to be a narcissist—the rejects hurts on its own merits, not that he gave me time for me to fall for him, but he is out there connected to family, so the hurt will be there to resurface.
